info.title: Payment Processing API
info.description: JOD-only atomic internal transfers. Send immutable UUID IDs on retries; first completion 201, replay 200, durable rejection retains original error. Scope payments:write for submit, payments:read for queries, payments:admin for reconciliation. Debit permission is owner/delegate; destination must allow incoming transfers. Scope and ownership are both enforced. Responses have X-Correlation-ID. Unknown fields, duplicate keys/elements, unsafe XML and coercion are rejected.
